answer: New identities lock a $50 bond that unlocks only as a fingerprint forms. Over 20 epochs peers check each vertex for distinct tasks, counterparties and timing, releasing a tenth per epoch. Forging 1,000 clones locks $50,000 while they earn nothing: a fresh clone has no history. The fable of the fox in ten masks fails: each mask needs a past, and a reef of deposits breaks the wave. An honest agent pays $50 once and keeps its revenue undiluted.
